notes.title: Patch Notes v1.34
notes.notes:
While working on our Xbox Release, we've made some performance updates and other small tweaks:

	[h3]Patch Notes v1.34[/h3]
	[b]Updates[/b]
	[list]
	[*] Minor artwork updates to weapons, controllables, and some baddies
	[*] Updated weapons in Autumn and Halloween themes to be cooler and generally more awesome
	[*] Updated friendly fire rules so your controllables and bullets (including from grenades) don't hit you or your teammates
	[*] Performance updates (centering around collision detection and AI drawing)
	[*] Updated bullet rendering so they don't render underneath the gun firing them
	[*] Updated off-screen player pointers to reduce UI clutter and be more clear
	[/list]

	[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
	[list]
	[*] Fixed bug causing flags to not fade out correctly when dropped in battle mode
	[*] Fixed robust error reporting when loading custom levels from the workshop (or directly from the level editor)
	[/list]

Over the last week we were experimenting with some input handling changes, if you experience any problems with your controller (like it not working, or being recognized as the wrong device), make sure Steam Input is not disabled for Cymatically Muffed, and that your Controller Configuration is set to our Official Recommended Configuration. (If you have not manually changed this, you shouldn't need to worry about it)

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.1
notes.notes:
[h3]Patch Notes v1.1[/h3]
[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added new Supporter Pack DLC (Supporter Edition)
[*] Minor editor and documentation updates
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed minor bug with logo rendering
[*] Fixed color shading on exploding players' and civilians' particle effects
[*] Fixed controllable rockets in-game placement offset
[*] Fixed AIs being alerted to a player's position when damaged by that player's controllable (or controllable payload - grenades, etc)

notes.title: Localization Update & New Weapons
notes.notes:
[h2]The localization for all 9 languages that Muffed currently supports is now up-to-date![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35262558/ec6f39b081862c8b48f33e354c6a30855e502178.png[/img]
Languages can be accessed from the Language Option in the Main Menu. Not seeing a language you think we should support? Let us know in the comments and we'll add it to the list of requested features!
[h2]
We've also added some new weapons; find them in the campaign and battle maps![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35262558/1d78861f7486900986e7e81c46ebb6603741f3b3.gif[/img]
This weapons update puts us at 60 available weapons! Do you have a favorite?

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.71
notes.notes:
If you're opted in to Steam Beta, you can use Steam Remote Play Together to play Muffed online with friends! More information can be found [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/593110/announcements/detail/3032537193879549687]here[/url].

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] Added campaign level 07 "Inner Base"
[*] Added campaign level 08 "Outer Base"
[*] Added campaign level 10 "A Way Out"
[*] Updated public level editor to include Campaign and Survival functionality
[*] Documentation has been updated to reflect all changes
[*] Added distance limit to turret and door sounds
[*] Added "Custom" difficulty menu
[*] Added footprints
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] All known bugs have been fixed :D
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.29
notes.notes:
[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
[*] added map "Embassy"
[*] added map "Cul De Sac"
[*] added map "Snipe Bases"
[*] decreased default zoom speed
[*] updated Puc mode to only trigger heavy hit when hitter has active muffs
[*] added "Suicides" player stat and sound effect
[*] all throwables now deal damage (coffee cups, pillows, etc)
[*] added player stat for Throwable Kills
[*] added "Bouncy Bullets" Ridiculous Option
[*] slowed down particle effects
[*] updated bullet collision to include anything that blocks movement
[*] made Puc solid (blocks movement)
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed menu control issue with setting Multiplayer Rendering options during gameplay
[*] fixed issue causing music to crash
[*] fixed "Random Weapons" setting breaking the flag spawns in Capture The Flag mode
[*] set player "scores" stat to only increment when they score in the opponent's goal (Puc mode)
[*] fixed issue causing inability to pickup objects on wall shelves
[*] fixed rare issue causing game to render off-screen after changing input settings
[*] fixed objects spawning inside of other objects (throwables, shells, etc)
[*] fixed issue allowing melee hit through walls and doors
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes v0.28
notes.notes:

[*] drop keycards on death
[*] removed input device flags rendering on scores screen without input device connectivity activity
